data.standardized_narrative: At 1 January 2024 gross claims outstanding were GBP 912.625m. During 2024 the Syndicate recorded a net favourable prior-year movement in gross claims of GBP 30.298m (a c.3.3% release of opening reserves). The release reflects favourable claims development and reinsurance recoveries which outweighed adverse development from named events (including exposure to Baltimore Bridge and hurricanes Helene and Milton) and geopolitical losses related to the war in Ukraine (the latter increased net reserves, largely on the 2021 year of account).
